name: incidentmtl
description: Published Montréal crime data by neighbourhood and borough: safety profiles, side-by-side comparisons, trend checks and recent records, in English and French.

interface.longDescription:
Published Montréal crime data, by neighbourhood and borough. Ask whether an area is safe, compare areas for a move, check whether a kind of crime is really rising, or see what was reported nearby this week.

Answers use SPVM police reports, SIM fire and medical interventions, City of Montréal 311 requests and press reports, with each source's last published day. Figures are published open data, never live. English and French.
defaultPrompt: Is NDG a safe place to live?
Compare Rosemont and Ahuntsic for a family.
Quel est le quartier le plus dangereux de Montréal?

positive.prompt: Is NDG a safe place to live?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls area_profile for Notre-Dame-de-Grâce and answers with its crime reports per 1,000 residents against the island's, its rank and the six kinds of crime, quoting the 12-month window and the last published day.

positive.prompt: Quel est le quartier le plus dangereux de Montréal?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_areas with ranking most, answers in French with the boroughs with the most reports per resident, and notes that areas with many visitors and few residents rate high.

positive.description: Compare two boroughs for a move
positive.prompt: Rosemont or Ahuntsic for a family: which has less crime?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_areas for the two boroughs and compares their rates per resident and kinds of crime, with the island for scale.

positive.description: Is a kind of crime rising
positive.prompt: Is car theft going down in Montréal?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls trend_check for vehicle theft on the island and reports the five annual periods and whether the change meets the threshold for a clear change.

positive.prompt: What has been reported in Hochelaga this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls recent_events (asking which Hochelaga is meant if the result is ambiguous) and lists the published records newest first, with each source's last published day, never as live.

negative.description: Not a crime or safety question
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Montréal tomorrow?
Which Toronto neighbourhood has the least crime?

fr-CA.subtitle: Criminalité à Montréal
fr-CA.description:
Les données publiées sur la criminalité à Montréal, par quartier et par arrondissement. Demandez si un secteur est sécuritaire, comparez des quartiers pour un déménagement, vérifiez si un type de crime augmente vraiment ou voyez ce qui a été signalé près de chez vous cette semaine.

Les réponses utilisent les signalements du SPVM, les interventions du SIM, les requêtes 311 de la Ville de Montréal et la presse, avec la dernière journée publiée de chaque source. Ce sont des données ouvertes publiées, jamais en direct. En français et en anglais.
